page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2s.xlarge is a virtualized server type within the compute-optimized GPU family running on KVM hypervisor infrastructure. It is configured with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz, delivering 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. System memory totals 8.0 GB, allocating 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a fractional 0.0833 slice of an NVIDIA A10 GPU equipped with 2 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include onboard local storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate balanced single-thread performance, posting a Geekbench single-core score of 1595.0 and a stress-ng single-core result of 1884.98. Multi-core performance is constrained by the 2-core physical limit, yielding a stress-ng multi-core metric of 5733.3 and Geekbench multi-core score of 4061.0. For machine learning tasks, the instance achieves 414.01 tokens per second for prompt processing and 117.31 tokens per second for text generation using a small 135M parameter model. Text generation throughput degrades significantly to 4.57 tokens per second on 7B models, limited by the 2 GB VRAM capacity. Memory bandwidth benchmarks average 49.58 GB/sec for uncached read-only streams and 33.25 GB/sec for write operations.

The fractional GPU provisioning offers qualitative cost efficiency for environments requiring GPU driver access and minor hardware acceleration without the overhead of reserving a full GPU card. Tradeoffs center on the tight 2 GB VRAM boundary and complete reliance on remote network-attached disks for storage. Workload fit includes lightweight virtual workstation tasks, basic 2D and 3D application rendering, small-parameter inference testing, and general compute jobs requiring minor GPU offloading.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2s.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance equipped with fractional GPU acceleration, operating on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz, supported by 8.0 GB of RAM. Visual and mathematical acceleration is supplied by a 0.0833 fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU with 2 GB of VRAM. It has no local storage and maintains a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. Benchmarks reflect balanced single-core execution with a Geekbench score of 1595.0 and steady throughput on small 135M language models at 117.31 tokens per second for generation. Multi-core compute and larger model inference are restricted by physical core counts and the 2 GB VRAM limit. This configuration is best fitted for entry-level virtual workstations, light graphics handling, and small-scale AI inference.
